intent: Android Agent WebRTC initialization does not terminate when a PC Viewer starts a remote connection.
rollback: Revert the JNI keep rule and release verifier change, then redeploy the prior signed Android Agent APK.

requestReview.reason: The R8 keep rule and offline release-mapping verifier alter neither application requests nor diagnostic collector behavior.
requestReview.assumptions: No request lifecycle changes are included.

outcomes.acceptance: PC Viewer Connect while Android Agent is in background does not terminate the Agent; consent and approved first-frame delivery remain available.
outcomes.verification: 2026-09-06: physical Android 16 arm64 v0.1.83 log proves libjingle_peerconnection_so aborts because R8 removed org.jni_zero.JniInit. npx vitest run src/androidNativeRelease.test.ts passed 5 tests, including the JniInit keep rule and missing-mapping rejection. The existing v0.1.83 mapping now correctly fails verify-native-release.mjs for JniInit, proving it cannot pass a future Android release gate.
outcomes.physicalGap: Build and install a newly signed Android Agent on the reported Android 16 arm64 device, then verify background Viewer request, approval, first frame, disconnect and repeat connection.
